name: Horní Loučky (Czechia)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of white over green separated by an arched line, with a green arched stripe in the white.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 8 June 2004 (decision No. 37) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
